coverage_questions: The paper documents H2O as an image-to-spatial-omics framework and does not document a natural-language text-input pathway; its “text embedding” h_i is derived from gene/spot data.

The equations for scGPT token construction, expression binning, embedding fusion, image projection, FiLM, and decoder computation are not decoded in the supplied text; those boundaries remain unresolved where algebra or exact order is unavailable.

The paper names five H2O configurations/routes in the atlas seed, while the supplied text additionally documents distinct HTSA, OpenST, benchmark, alignment, decoder-training, and HTAPP application contexts; these are represented as separate task trajectories where their receiving components differ.

operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no operation for encoding raw image pixels with a ViT. project applies after numerical features already exist, while lookup and reshape do not represent the documented ViT computation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: 1D convolution followed by global average pooling
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog can represent stacking with concatenate, but it has no primitive for the stated convolution-plus-GAP computation.

operation_proposals.source_operation: FiLM feature-wise scaling and shifting conditioned on spot diameter
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog has no conditional feature-wise affine modulation operation. project can represent generation of FiLM parameters, but not the subsequent scale-and-shift application.
align represents correspondence alignment, not the documented positive/negative pair contrastive objective with temperature-scaled similarity and within-modality cosine smoothing.
